WeaponPerks.Name: Chaos Reshaped
WeaponPerks.Description:
After having maintained a state of dealing or receiving damage every 5 seconds for at least 12 ↑11.5 seconds:
Chaos Reshaped x1 | 20% Increased damage for 7 seconds. 
Dealing or receiving damage refreshes the buff duration. 
Buff can be activated while stowed, and persists through stow.

After maintaining Chaos Reshaped x1 for an additional 12 ↑11.5 seconds:
Chaos Reshaped x2 | 35% Increased damage for 7 seconds and triggers a healing effect while active.
Dealing or receiving damage refreshes the buff duration. 
Buff can be activated while stowed, and persists through stow.

Chaos Reshaped x2 Healing Effect
Charges up a Healing-over-time effect at a rate of 5 HP/s while readied, automatically triggering after either charging 35 HP (7 seconds) or stowing the weapon.
The Healing Effect restores 5 HP/s equal to the charge built, effectively becoming constant if the weapon is readied for 7 seconds.
Healing Effect prevents HP gains from non-Chaos Reshaped x2 sources above (200 - Healing Charge Built) HP if active. <100 Health Stat = 200 HP
Healing Effect is not visually reduced by Brawn's Healing Penalties, resulting in a rubberbanding health bar as it triggers.
  In practice, just takes this as a 5HP/s effect as the missing nonrestorable HP is covered by the Healing Effect anyway. Don't overthink it!

↑Reduces the time needed in-combat to grant a stack of Chaos Reshaped to 11.5 seconds.

WeaponPerks.Name: Headseeker
WeaponPerks.Description:
Upon dealing direct non-Precision Weapon Damage:
Grants increased Precision Damage and 3?% Increased Auto Aim Cone Size for 0.55 seconds. 
Dealing additional Non-Precision Damage refreshes the buff duration.
The perk actually multiplies the Precision Bonus by 1.2x, but the actual Precision Damage Increase results are easier to explain.

Precision Damage Increase per Intrinsic Frame:
Adaptive Pulse = 7.1% | Aggressive Pulse = 10% | Heavy Burst Pulse = 9.5%
High-Impact Pulse = 8.74% | Lightweight Pulse = 6.3% | Rapid-Fire Pulse = 10.3%
Adaptive Burst Sidearm = 8.46% | Heavy Burst Sidearm = 7.36%
Precision Scout Rifle = 8.66%
Heavy Burst Hand Cannon = 7% increased Weakspot Damage.

↑Passively grants +5 Stability.

What even is a Weakspot? How is it different from a Precision Hit?
Weakspot Hits that do not register as a Precision Hit can still benefit or trigger Weakspot effects, such as Headseeker, or Heavy Burst Hand Cannon's intrinsic 9.5% Weakspot Damage Buff.
Similarly, Precision Hits are not always scored on Weakspots, and may not trigger Weakspot effects.
One such example are Shielded Combatants. Weakspot Damage Increases will work when other Precision Hit Increases wouldn't.

↑Damage Increase begins at 18.8% [12.54%] and ends at 45% [30%]. Results in a 28.3% [19.02%] Average Damage Increase over a full Magazine.

 Kinetic Weapons instead spawn an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.

Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Stasis Shards = 5 seconds.
Tangles = 12 seconds

Kills during Synergy's cooldown do not contribute to the activation.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Synergy
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Scoring 12 ↑8 [6 ↑4?] Weapon Kills spawns a Weapon Element-Matching Subclass Pickup.
 Kinetic Weapons instead spawn an Orb of Power that grants 7.15% Super Energy.
Kill counter persists through stow.

Synergy ignores the global cooldown for Pickups, but will trigger the global cooldown upon spawning one.
Synergy has its own cooldown depending on the spawned Pickup:
Ionic Traces = 0 seconds
Firesprites, Void Breaches, and Stasis Shards = 5 seconds.
Tangles = 12 seconds
Can spawn 2 Pickups simultaneously if the 12th kill would also trigger a different Pickup spawner.

Kills during Synergy's cooldown do not contribute to the activation.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Balanced Heat Weapon
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon beginning a Manual Vent while Heat is ≥875:
2x Vent Rate Multiplier.

Primary Ammo Balanced Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 20% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.

Additional information regarding Heat Weapons.

IntrinsicTraits.Name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
IntrinsicTraits.Description:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon cancelling a Manual Vent while Heat is ≤125:
Dynamic Heat Limiter | -50% Heat Generation for 5 seconds or until stowing the weapon.
Triggering Dynamic Heat Limiter through reload or sprint after having dealt damage will freeze the timer until shooting.

Primary Ammo Dynamic Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 15% Increased Impact Damage to Rank-and-File, and 38% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.
Additionally, they deal 2.5% increased direct damage to Guardians.

Additional information regarding Heat Weapons.

ArmorSets.Name: Revving Up
ArmorSets.Description:
While Movement Speed is at least ?m/s:
Grants a stack of Revving Up, with a maximum of 10 stacks.
Transforms into Fully Revved at 10 stacks.

Each Revving Up stack grants increased Critical Health Regeneration Speed. Does not affect Shields in any way.
By default, it takes 1.75 seconds for Critical Health to begin regenerating at a rate of 27.5%HP/s.
At x5 stacks, it takes 1.5 seconds to begin regenerating at a rate of ~37.5% HP/s.

Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.

+50 Mobility, 33% Increased Slide Distance, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds.

While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:

Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.

Being Amplified enhances certain Abilities.

ArcVerbs.Name: Bolt Charge
ArcVerbs.Description:
Damage instances scored within 3 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active increments a Magazine-capacity based counter towards gaining a stack of Bolt Charge.
Grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, up to 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Gaining a stack through damage prevents simultaneous damage instances from incrementing the counter.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 2
Area-Denial GLs: 3 or 4?
Swords: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1
Glaive Melee, as well as Damage-over-Time sources all count.

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Ground Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Ground Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.
Does not count as Ability Damage.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Gifted Conviction's Explosives

SolarVerbs.Name:
Solar Effect
Damage Scaling
SolarVerbs.Description:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.
 
Applying a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent/Burning Ambition or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as other Damage Perks, Weapon Stat, Radiant, and Solar Weapon Surges.
New Gear Bonus is applied permanently to all Weapons, so all Solar Effect Damage against Combatants will always be 5% higher than expected.

Applying Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

SolarSubclass.Name: Song of Flame
SolarSubclass.Description:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [~50?%]
Base Duration: 25 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second.

Song of Flame:
Caster is granted +100 Grenade, +100 Melee, +100 Class, Radiant and Scorching Rounds. 
Weapon Kills by the Caster count as Super Kills. Weapon damage does not count as Ability damage.
Allies within 15 metres are granted 30% [?%] Damage Resist, Scorching Rounds, and 15% Fixed Bonus Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy per second.
Grants full Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on Super End.

Scorching Rounds:
Dealing Direct Kinetic or Solar Weapon Damage inflicts Scorch, with the stack amount and cooldown between Scorch applications varying per Weapon Type.
x3+2 Scorch every 0.2 seconds = Auto Rifles | Submachine Guns
x5+5 Scorch every 0.2? seconds = Machine Guns | Trace Rifles
x10+5 Scorch every 0.6 seconds = Hand Cannon | Pulse Rifle | Scout Rifles | Sidearms
x15+5 Scorch every 0.4 seconds = Fusion Rifles | Glaive (Melee/Projectile) | Shotgun | Sniper Rifle | Swords (+Solar Ergo Sum)
x20+10 Scorch every 0.6? seconds = Bows | Heavy Grenade Launchers | Special Grenade Launchers | Linear Fusion Rifles (+Arbalest) | Rocket Launchers
Double Fire Grenade Launchers can inflict x40+x20 Scorch in a single shot.

Grenade Ability: Drains 4.8% Super Energy, and has a 2 second cooldown between usages.
Sends forth a homing Solar Wisp that detonates on impact, dealing up to 685 [?] damage and inflicting x40+20 Scorch. Wisps have ? HP.
Another Wisp is spawned on the impact location if an enemy is within 15? meters, chasing towards the closest enemy it hasn't already damaged.
Can spawn up to 3 additional Wisps per ability usage.
Consuming a Solar Wisp while Heat Rises is equipped grants Cure x3 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds to the user and their allies within 9 meters.

Melee Ability: Drains 2.4% Super Energy, and has a 1.75 second cooldown between usages.
Celestial Fire sends out 5 Solar blasts, each dealing up to 200 [87] damage and inflicting x10+5 Scorch.
Incinerator Snap releases a barrage of 7 Solar Sparks, each dealing up to 155 [41] damage and inflicting x20+10 [x10+5] Scorch.
[Auto Melee] against an enemy within Melee Lunge Distance while Incinerator Snap is equipped performs an Enhanced Basic Melee that deals 1000 [456] Solar Damage and inflicts x60+30 Scorch over a tiny radius, consuming Super Energy and a Melee Ability Charge.

Class Ability: Drains 6% Super Energy, and has a 2.85 second cooldown between usages.
Functions as the selected Class Ability, recharging quickly at the cost of Super Energy.

VoidVerbs.Name: Invisibility
VoidVerbs.Description:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were.

Slowed Enemies receive multiple penalties related to movement or weapon performance.
Freeze occurs upon reaching x100 Slow.

Slowed Combatants have 50% Decreased Movement Speed and are less accurate.

Eg: 160 Reload Speed will be reduced be 40 Reload Speed. 80 Handling would be reduced to 20 Handling.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Alethonym
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Stasis Micro-Missile Grenade Launcher Rifle
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. Deals 40% increased damage against Rank-and-File Combatants (compared to Exotic Primary's 30%)

Fires Harvester Spikes in a straight line, dealing 43 [39] Impact Damage, and up to 697 [91] Explosive Damage, down to 30% damage over 5 meters.
Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses become impaled on direct hits, being dealt 79 Damage every 0.8 seconds up to 6 times over 4 seconds. 
Impaled Enemies trigger the Harvester Spike Explosion on the sixth tick, removing the impaled projectile.
Impale Damage is non-lethal. There is no limit to the amount of simultaneous impales on a single enemy.

Kills create a floating Vestige that home in towards the user. Picking up a Vestige grants Vestigial Alchemy Energy.
Picking up 7 Vestiges totals 50% Vestige Energy. Requires an additional 10 Vestiges (17 Total) to reach 100% Energy.
Impaled Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses spawn a Vestige every time Impale damage ticks, spawning up to 6 Vestiges on a single shot.

Holding [Reload] while Vestigial Alchemy is at least at 50% Energy toggles between Firing Modes.
50%–99% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode | 100% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode -> Heavy Ammo Mode
Ammo-Loaded Shots deplete Vestigial Alchemy Energy, and always explode on hit, meaning they cannot impale Combatants.

Special Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Special Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 50% Vestigial Energy.
Special Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

Heavy Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 100% Vestigial Energy.
Heavy Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

↑Catalyst:
Grants the One For All trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Barrow-Dyad
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Strand Aggressive Submachine Gun
Behaves differently depending on the current Path.

Automatically refills magazine-based Ammo every 0.2 seconds while not firing, refilling up to 34 Ammo over 4.85 seconds.
1-2 Ammo = 4 Refill per tick | 3-8 Ammo = 3 Refill | 9-16 Ammo = 2 Refill | 17 or higher = 1 Refill
Firing delays refilling to 0.285 seconds. Can fire permanently at 1 Ammo at 240?RPM. Refills to 34 Ammo to not prevent reloading.

Dealing damage charges Blight at a rate of 2% Blight per damage instance, reaching 100% Blight after dealing damage 50 times.
Blight decays at a rate of 3.33% every 1.2 seconds after not firing for 1.3 seconds, fully decaying after 41.1 seconds.
Grants increased Reload Speed based on the amount of Blight Seekers prepared.
Blight charge persists through stow, and decays normally.

On Reload:
Triggers Panic Response, converting all stored Blight into Blighted Seekers, at a rate of 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers.
Always rounds up to the nearest Seeker number. Eg: 1% Blight = 1 Seeker, 52% = 4 Seekers, 84% = 6 Seekers. 
Blight Seekers are fired at a rate of 450RPM Hipfire | 720RPM ADS, overwriting regular shots.
Panic Response lasts for 7 seconds, and persists through stow.

Taken Resolution
Dealing damage to 3 enemies within ? seconds of each grants 50% Blight.
Blighted Seekers deal 173 [6.85 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Damage over 3? meters on hit.
Blight Seekers pierce through enemies, seeking a maximum of 2 additional enemies within 10? meters of each.
Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

Taken Ambition
Scoring 12 damage instances within 1 seconds of each on a single enemy or construct grants 22% Blight. Due to rounding, dealing damage 24 times is enough to grant 6 Seekers.
Blighted Seekers explode on impact, dealing 45 [9?] Impact Damage and 542 [21?] Explosive Damage over 0.25? meters.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in High-Impact Reserves, Hatchling, One For All, or Target Lock trait equivalents.
ExoticWeapons.Comment:
Panic Response I–V
Taken Divergence
↑Craftable Trait

ExoticWeapons.Name: Cerberus +1
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Quad-Barrel High-Impact Auto Rifle
Deals 85% of the damage of a High-Impact Auto Rifle.
Has reverse damage falloff at close ranges for both firing modes.  Deals 75% decreased damage to Stasis Crystals.

Each shot fires 4 evenly spread pellets in a triangular shape, with one always landing within the Accuracy Cone.
Each pellet deals up to 44 [20.4] damage with a 1.77x Precision Multiplier.
ADS grants -25% Pellet Spread.

Decreases damage dealt the closer an enemy is, up to a maximum of 16.67% Decreased Damage at point blank, scaling up to base damage at 14 metres. 
The ADS Damage Falloff Scalar of 1.6x increases the minimum distance to reach base damage to 22 meters.

ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Aggressive Fusion Rifle
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Replaces Melee Ability with the weapon's Frontal Blades capable of performing a swift two-hit combo with an extended 7 meter lunge.
Each strike deals 543 [84] Kinetic Damage. Frontal Blades deal 50% increased Melee Damage on Corrupted Enemies.
Frontal Blade Damage scales with Melee Stat and Melee Damage Buffs. It is NOT a Glaive Melee.

Upon scoring 2 Frontal Blade Strikes within 2? seconds of each or a Frontal Blade Kill:
Grants a stack of Soulfire Charges, up to a maximum of 6 stacks and restores 40 HP.
Stacks are only consumed upon firing or on death.

Fires an increasingly wider 3 round burst of 4 projectiles each.
Projectiles deal 143 [?] Kinetic Damage.
Consumes a stack of Soulfire Charge to inflict Potent Corruption on enemies.
Potent Corruption deals 65 [?] Kinetic Damage every 0.5 seconds, ramping up by ~8.7% per tick over 20 ticks, up to a final tick of 300 [?] Damage, totalling 2,985 [?] Damage.

Soulfire Charge's Potent Corruption causes enemies to create a Soulfire Crystal on death.

Soulfire Crystals are Constructs with 400? HP that linger for 15 seconds, exploding upon being reduced to 0 HP.
Soulfire Crystal Explosion deals up to 1,065 [?] Kinetic Damage over 8 meters, down to 75% Damage.

Soulfire Zeal | Soulfire Crystal Explosions within 15 meters grant maximized movement speed and 20?% Damage Resist for +7 seconds, up to 20 seconds.

Soulfire Skewer | Soulfire Crystal Explosions within 15 meters grant Frontal Blades the ability to inflict Corruption for +7 seconds, up to 20 seconds.
Corruption deals 16 per tick every 0.5 seconds up to 10 times per infliction and can stack.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Khvostov 7G-0X
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Adaptive Auto Rifle

Picking up an Orb of Power grants x7 stacks of Eyes Up, Guardian. (A full magazine worth of enhanced ricochets)
Eyes Up, Guardian stacks persist through stow.

Every shot in the magazine divisible by 7 fires a ricochetting bullet that deals 252.52% [5% Guardians | 252.52% Constructs] increased damage with +50% Auto Aim Cone Size.
Rounds that ricochet off of enemies bounce towards the closest enemy within 8? [5?] meters, dealing 108 [4.6] damage.

Firing a ricochetting round while Eyes Up, Guardian is active consumes a stack, enhancing the ricochetting bullet.
Enhanced Ricochetting Bullets bounce up to 7 times between enemies within 12? [?] meters. Enemies can only be damaged twice by the same ricochetting bullet.

↑Catalyst: Grants the Attrition Orbs trait.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Lumina
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Kinetic Adaptive Hand Cannon

Kills create a floating Remnant that homes in towards the user while within 15 metres. 
Remnants refill 4 Ammo and grant 1 Noble Round on pickup, up to a maximum of 6 Noble Rounds. Boots of the Assembler' Noble Seekers grant 1 Noble Rounds.
Noble Round stacks persist through stow.

Hipfiring releases a Noble Round, which aggressively seeks the closest ally.
Noble Rounds restore 90 HP to the ally, and grant Blessing of the Sky to both the wielder and the ally.

35% [15%] increased damage and +100 Class Stat for 11 seconds.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Osteo Striga
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Kinetic Precision Submachine Gun
Counts as a Weapon of Sorrow.

Fires slow, seeking projectiles that deal ~10.8% increased damage over a Precision Submachine Gun's.

Scoring 14 Hits or 7 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each or scoring a kill triggers a Potent Corruption Burst centered on the enemy, corrupting enemies within 5 metres.

Potent Corruption mechanics are identical to Necrotic Grips. Incurs a 2-second cooldown between poison bursts on death.
Osteo Striga's Potent Corruption is affected by Buffs, Debuffs, Exotic Primary Rank-and-File Bonus, and the Kinetic Damage Bonus. 
Reinflicting Potent Corruption resets the stacking damage.

↑Osteo Striga Catalyst:
Passively grants +20 Stability and +30 Reload Speed.
 Poison Kills refill 100% of Magazine, and can overflow up to 300% Increased Magazine Capacity.
Incurs a 0.5 seconds cooldown between Ammo Overflows.
ExoticWeapons.Comment:

Toxic Overload
↑Osteo Striga Catalyst

ExoticWeapons.Name: Revision Zero
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Kinetic Pulse Rifle
Selectable Origin Traits, between Heavy Burst Frames and Aggressive Burst Frames. 

Scoring 12 Precision Hits grants a stack of Targeting Data, up to 4 stacks after 48 Precision Hits.

Hunter's Trace:
Hold [Reload] while at least one stack of Targeting Data is loaded to swap into Hunter's Trace. Ammo loaded is equal to the amount of Targeting Data stacks acquired.
Replaces the 18 Zoom Scope with a 50 Zoom Scope. Fires with perfect accuracy, and has a Red Sniper Rifle Glint.
Fires High-Damage Hunter's Trace Rounds that deal 564 [158] Damage with a 3.25x Precision Multiplier at 72RPM and inherit the Shield-Piercing effect.
Scoring a Hunter's Trace hit triggers a Kinetic Shockwave that deals up to 322 [20] Damage, down to 0% damage, and exhausts for 5 seconds over 6 meters.
Hunter's Trace persists through stow and can only be deactivated by fully emptying the magazine or dying.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in Feeding Frenzy, Fourth Time's The Charm, Outlaw, or Under Pressure trait equivalents. Fourth Time's The Charm allows firing up to 6 Sniper Shots.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Wish-Keeper
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Craftable Strand Precision Bow

Precision Hits and Kills charge up Snareweaver Arrows. Snareweaver requires 6 charges to be activated.
Precision Hits = 1 | Rank-and-File = 1 | Elite+ = 2 | Guardian = 3
When fully charged, hipfire to shoot a Snareweaver Arrow.

Snareweaver Arrow:
Hitting an enemy directly releases a snare underneath them and inflicts suspend.
Creates a snare with 6 linked traps in a ⏏ shape on impact. Traps last 15 seconds and have 10 HP. 
Enemies that come into contact with the linked traps are dealt 341 [5] damage and become suspended.
Suspending 2 enemies breaks a beam. A snare can suspend up to 6 enemies. 
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between repeated suspensions on a single enemy.

Deals 50% [20%] increased damage against Suspended enemies.
Bodyshot Hits against Suspended enemies deal an additional 50% increased damage. Displays as yellow numbers, but will not be counted as Precision Hits.
Precision Hits against Suspended Elite Combatants deal 701 damage while Bodyshots deal 806 damage.

Upon suspending an enemy, or upon damaging a Suspended enemy with this weapon:
+100 Reload Speed and 0.7x Draw Time Multiplier for ? seconds.

↑Catalyst grants multiple craftable traits:
Enduring Snare Refit increases Snareweaver Trap duration by +10 seconds, to 25 seconds.
Multi-threaded Snare Refit increases the maximum amount of suspensions per trap to 3, totalling a maximum of 18 suspensions. 
Hatchling trait or the Vorpal Weapon trait.

 Enemies that remain in the Precision Field for 3.75 seconds suffer from Penance, receiving 1,735 [520] damage. Damage assumes the weaken, of course.

Void Adaptive Trace Rifle
Intrinsically has a 1.4x PVE Bonus over Legendary Trace Rifles.

Kills collapse enemies into Transmutation Spheres with 30 Ammo. Spheres can remain on the ground for up to 30 seconds. 

Transmutation Spheres are pickupable objects that are able to use Light Attacks, Heavy Attacks, and Guard/Drain. Dropping a Transmutation Sphere immediately despawns it.
Ammo is passively drained at a rate of 1 Ammo Per Second. Attacking or Guarding disables passive drain until the Attack Animation is finished or until no longer Guarding.

Transmutation Spheres:
They are considered Generic Void Weapons, and their damage can be increased through Weapon Damage Buffs, as well as Activity Surges and other generic Void Damage buffs. 
They are also able to inflict Volatile through Volatile Rounds. 
Spheres will not trigger, nor be affected by any effect related to Melee Abilities, Void Abilities, Trace Rifles, or Weapon Surge Mods.

Light Attacks | Lunges forward, dealing 270 [150] damage, disorienting Combatants and consuming 1 Ammo. Airborne Attacks deal 25% decreased damage. Can attack twice every second.

Heavy Attacks | Slams the Sphere onto the ground, detonating it, dealing 1350 [300 Guardians | 1500 Constructs] damage without falloff and inflicting suppression to enemies within 5? metres. 
Damage is unaffected by the Ammo Remaining.

Guarding | Projects a draining field over a ? metre radius, dealing 28 [12] damage and restoring 5 HP per enemy hit every 0.3 seconds.
Grants 80% [50%] Damage Resist and prevents knockback while guarding. Combatants inside the draining field are disoriented.
Ammo Drains at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.25 seconds. The last remaining 3 Ammo drain at a rate of 1 Ammo every 0.5 seconds until 1 Ammo is left.

Guarding while at 1 Ammo inflicts Transfiguration, dealing increasingly higher self-damage every 0.7 seconds until no longer Guarding or death. 
Self-Damage inflicted maxes out at 100 damage per tick and ignores all Damage Resist. Will eventually outright kill after enough time.

Upon scoring a Transmutation Sphere Kill or upon damaging a Miniboss+ with a Transmutation Sphere:
30% [15%] increased damage for 7 seconds.

ExoticWeapons.Description:
Arc Rapid-Fire Scout Rifle. 
Hold [Reload] to switch to the Arc Seeker Mode.

Fires tracking bolts that deal up to 76 [50 Guardians | 25 Constructs] splash damage, down to 0% damage over a 3 meter radius at the cost of 2.6x Fire Recovery Delay.
Tracks to enemies within the aim-assist cone. Deals no self-damage.
Switching to Arc Seeker refills the magazine by an amount equal to Dynamic Charge stacks.

Precision Hits and Kills grant a stack of Dynamic Charge, up to a maximum of 15 stacks.
Dynamic Charge stacks each grant 30% [complicated, x3 = 3 STK and x7+ = 2STK | 30% Constructs] increased damage and increased splash radius to Arc Seeker mode.
x10 = 4 meter radius | x20 = 7 meter radius

Bolt Discharge triggered via Arc Seeker Hits count as Scout Rifle Primary Weapon Damage and are scaleable with both Combatant Scalars and Weapon Buffs.
Storm's Keep (and Well of Radiance's Caster) cause Bolt Discharge to occur twice simultaneously, with one counting as Weapon Damage and the other being a regular discharge.
Stacks multiplicatively with Flashover's 50% increase. 
Casting Well of Radiance while behind a Storm's Keep Barricade will trigger 1 Symmetry Discharge and 2 Regular Discharges.

↑Electric Styx:
Dynamic Charge can now stack up to x20.

ExoticWeapons.Name: Winterbite
ExoticWeapons.Description:
Solar Heavy Axe
Uses Twilight Arsenal's Axes Animations. Sword Energy is visibly displayed in the Melee Ability icon.

Light Attacks deal 470 [377] Damage grant 30% Sword Energy and spawn 3 Quicksilver Nanites every 3 attacks or on kill.
Heavy Attacks, while having at least 10% Sword Energy, consume 3 Ammo to launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters forward, dealing 675 [301] Damage.
Airborne Heavy Attacks consume 2 Ammo and always send out a Solar Wave, regardless of Sword Energy.
Wolfsbane deals up to 25% increased damage against enemies with Outbreak Perfected's Nanites.

Quicksilver Nanites restore ? HP on pickup and grant ~4.5% Nano-Assault progress, requiring 21 Nanites to max out.
Hold [Reload] upon reaching 100% Nano-Assault to trigger Overclock.
Quicksilver Nanites generated from attacks against ~~ A F F L I C T E D enemies with Outbreak Perfected Nanites grant ?% increased Nano Assault progress.

Overclock | Enhanced Offensive Capabilities for 12 seconds.

Heavy Attacks always launch a Solar Wave.
Fully Charged Heavy Attacks's Solar Wave explodes, dealing 421?? [376] Damage over ? meters and create a Swarm-Nado. Explosion has no falloff.
Swarm-Nado deals 55? [55] Damage every 0.3 seconds over 5? meters for 3 seconds.

Grants Damage Resist for 5 seconds upon scoring Light Attack Hits within 3? seconds of each.
Damage Resist strength and hit requirements are variable, with both being determined by the equipped handle.
Unyielding = 15% DR after 2 hits | Rampager's = 20% DR after 3 hits | Tenacious = 25% DR after 4 hits
Can be triggered even without Ammo. Can be refreshed by retriggering the Damage Resist effect.
